description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jinx''' tosses out 3 ''Chompers'' centered at the target location, landing after 0.4 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal magic damage to nearby enemies.
description.text: Active: Jinx tosses out 3 Chompers centered at the target location, landing after 0.4 seconds, arming after 0.5 seconds, and exploding after 5 seconds to deal magic damage to nearby enemies.

description2.raw: Each ''Chomper'' explodes on contact with an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|knocking them down]] and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooting]] them for 1.5 seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one ''Chomper''.
description2.text: Each Chomper explodes on contact with an enemy champion, knocking them down and rooting them for 1.5 seconds. Enemy champions can be affected by only one Chomper.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
90 / 140 / 190 / 240 / 290 (+ 100% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Chompers'' will halt when encountering [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] and [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] does not negate the explosion. * Each ''Chomper'' gives vision of its surrounding area.
notes.text:
Chompers will halt when encountering Wind Wall and Unbreakable.
Spell shield does not negate the explosion.
Each Chomper gives vision of its surrounding area.
